rationale: Luke brings full-stack AI and generative video expertise from Infinity AI Institute, while Ahmad is pioneering AI-native hardware form factors at Midjourney—a natural fit for exploring how generative AI models integrate deeply with novel hardware interfaces. Both are SF-based and share conviction around next-generation AI applications beyond traditional wearables, and Ahmad's spatial computing and hand-tracking background (Vision Pro, Leap Motion) could inform the interaction modalities for Luke's generative video and adaptive learning work.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Ahmad Abbas — you're both architecting how AI gets experienced at the hardware-software boundary, and Ahmad's pioneering new AI device categories at Midjourney could unlock novel interfaces for generative and educational AI tools.
